headline: Two Punk Legends Help Revive a Cult Band’s Archive
context: The Cramps introduced the world to “psychobilly” and turned Henry Rollins and Ian MacKaye into fans. Now the duo is part of an effort to bring the music back.

sources.name: The New York Times
